visualCharacteristics.purpose: media (logo, photo or stat graphic) side by side with a short text column
visualCharacteristics.layout: two equal columns on desktop, stacked on mobile

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: image | text (optional H2 heading + paragraph)

suitableFor: brand/partner logo next to a statement
image beside a heading and paragraph
stat graphic beside a supporting sentence
notSuitableFor: three or more equal content columns (use columns)
